# Hira Ahmed

- Identity: Hira Ahmed
- Roles: AI Engineer; AI Automation & QA Engineer
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan; remote
- Portfolio: https://hira299.github.io/

Hira Ahmed builds production LLM pipelines, AI agents, and n8n automations, and provides B2B SaaS QA, API testing, and multi-tenant testing. Research work includes Sentinel-Mesh, a preprint on formally verified cloud-misconfiguration remediation.
